rows.label: bf03200100_0010
rows.name: How is she?

rows.label: bf03200100_0020
rows.name:
Her injuries aren't serious. Byakko says
she's just asleep from exhaustion.

rows.label: bf03200100_0030
rows.name: I see...

rows.label: bf03200100_0040
rows.name: Maybe...I used too much power again...

rows.label: bf03200100_0050
rows.name: Hey, Rex...

rows.label: bf03200100_0060
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]？

rows.label: bf03200100_0070
rows.name:
What do you think the difference is
between me and that Yoshitsune guy?

rows.label: bf03200100_0080
rows.name:
Well, he's a bad guy, trying to get
Homura...and you're...a good guy?

rows.label: bf03200100_0090
rows.name: Hah! That's nice of you to say, but...

rows.label: bf03200100_0100
rows.name:
What if I told you that we
weren't that different?

rows.label: bf03200100_0110
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]え？

rows.label: bf03200100_0120
rows.name:
The people in the village believe
they're fighting for justice.

rows.label: bf03200100_0130
rows.name:
But, a just fight? I'm telling
you now, there's no such thing.

rows.label: bf03200100_0140
rows.name:
People just use 'justice' to suit themselves.
War is war.

rows.label: bf03200100_0150
rows.name:
The more you try to protect
yourself, the more conflict arises.

rows.label: bf03200100_0160
rows.name: War is just that conflict on a larger scale.

rows.label: bf03200100_0170
rows.name:
Listen. All I'm saying is, we got
our fight, and he's got his.

rows.label: bf03200100_0180
rows.name: But what he's doing is-

rows.label: bf03200100_0190
rows.name:
Of course. I'm not defending what he's doing.
Rex, war is power.

rows.label: bf03200100_0200
rows.name:
And power can take many different forms.
It depends on the heart of its wielder.

rows.label: bf03200100_0210
rows.name:
If you fear power and stop trying to protect,
that's the end.

rows.label: bf03200100_0220
rows.name:
No one can decide what's right
and what's wrong.

rows.label: bf03200100_0230
rows.name:
Then protect what matters
to you to the very end.

rows.label: bf03200100_0240
rows.name: What's important...

rows.label: bf03200100_0250
rows.name: That's your war.

rows.label: bf03200100_0260
rows.name: My...war?
